schema_version.description: The explicit changed local contract version.

id.description: This value uniquely identifies the record within its declared entity and version scope.

format.description: This field names the exercise or file format specified by its parent contract.

public_context.description: This field contains task context that the teacher can read before submission.

target_locale.description: This field identifies the target English locale for the published variety policy.

accepted_varieties.description: These English varieties are permitted by the fixed case context.

register.description: This field states the social or institutional register required by the task.

assessment_basis.description: This field states the declared basis for judging the language target.

public_constraints.description: These conditions give the teacher the context necessary to judge the case fairly.

variety_policy.description: This object fixes locale, permitted varieties, register, and judgment basis.

duration_ms_min.description: Optional explicit duration bound in milliseconds. Null means a word-length request has no hard duration bound.

duration_ms_max.description: Optional explicit duration bound in milliseconds. Null means a word-length request has no hard duration bound.

id.description: This value uniquely identifies the record within its declared entity and version scope.

voice_profile_id.description: This identifier selects the registered voice profile for the speaker.

learner_cefr.description: Optional generated-text level. Null means unconstrained, not an inferred participant level.

l1.description: This field records the declared first language. It does not imply a particular error.

requested_accent.description: This field states an accent request. It does not prove the resulting accent.

pace_wpm.description: This field gives the speaker pace target in words per minute.

pace_tolerance_fraction.description: This field gives the allowed relative deviation from the requested pace.

speakers.description: These profiles specify the distinct speakers in the exercise.

taxonomy_id.description: This field references a registered category at the declared taxonomy version.

min_count.description: This field gives the minimum required number of target units.

max_count.description: This field gives the maximum permitted number of target units.

expected_judgment.description: This field states whether the reviewed unit is a true error, permitted control, or excluded item.

targets.description: Advanced exact leaf constraints. Empty delegates leaf selection to the mutation phase under exercise_request broad families.

detection.description: This flag states whether the task requests error detection.

classification.description: This flag states whether the task requests a category for each detected error.

correction.description: This flag or object describes correction requirements or decisions in its parent contract.

explanation.description: This flag or object describes explanation requirements or judgments in its parent contract.

task_components.description: These flags freeze the requested answer components before the attempt.

audio_origin_policy.description: This generation blueprint uses newly synthesized audio, locally or through a configured service. Separate native recording import remains supported without another owner approval.

provider_profile_id.description: This identifier selects one versioned provider configuration.

exercise_request.description: Original simple user input, retained alongside the expanded blueprint.
